concerns.text: FR-007 (descriptor‑target provenance independence) is not referenced in any phase or task description. The plan must include an explicit step (e.g., in Phase 1 or Phase 2) that verifies the target diffusion coefficient is never used as a predictor or in imputation/scaling, and that all proxy formulas are documented as independent of the target.

FR-008 (record measurement temperature as a predictor) is absent from the phase mapping. Add a task that ensures the temperature column is retained, logged, and included in all model pipelines (e.g., in Phase 1 ingestion and Phase 2 training).
